description: Python order-lifecycle library (place, deliver, cancel) whose scope names refunds but no refund rules

profile.PROJECT_NAME_AND_PURPOSE: shop-orders: order lifecycle library used by the internal fulfilment team
profile.PRIMARY_JOURNEYS: Place an order; mark it delivered; cancel an undelivered order; refund a delivered order at the customer's request
profile.SCOPE: Included: order lifecycle and customer refunds of delivered orders (refund rules not yet specified). Excluded: payments integration, storage, UI
profile.TECHNOLOGY_STACK: Python 3.10+ standard library; Decimal for money; no storage (callers persist orders)
profile.DATA_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARIES: Order totals and history are confidential business data; tests use synthetic orders only
